Marta_CS: Quiet flag — StrataLink (Enterprise) embed volume down ~54% over last 14 days. Renew in ~7w. Procurement asked for SOC2 + a side-by-side vs NovaAI (they're running a pilot). Champion Priya moved to a compliance role last sprint. Seat activity & embed routes most affected. Need quick triage + retention play. @Ethan_CSM @Ruben_SE can we coordinate outreach + a compliance + private-eval offer?

Ethan_CSM: Ack. Can you drop the dashboard link + top line delta? Also any billing churn or seat freezes visible?

Marta_CS: Dashboard: https://redwood.app/accounts/stratalink/usage — embeds -54% WoW, gen -9%, active API tokens -29%. No 5xx spike; small 429 bursts. No billing churn flags yet but procurement is actively questioning compliance posture.

Ruben_SE: Any recent model/variant swap or SDK change? Embeds usually tank if prefix caching broke or a quantized variant was ramped.

Marta_CS: Timeline has a routing change to `strata-embed-q` rolled to 70% on 2026-07-10 and a client SDK bump on 2026-07-11.

Ruben_SE: OK — likely perf/caching delta + client-side change. I'll pull KV cache hit rates, batching distribution, and per-route token-length histograms. Quick self-check we can give them: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/STRATALINK/kv_hits`

Olivia_RevOps: We can offer a targeted private-eval (VPC) for 14 days on their highest-volume embed route plus a one-off usage credit up to $9k. Need acct id and last invoice to authorize; legal will need to sign the private-eval addendum.

Priya_Security: I can prepare a 1-page SOC2 readiness summary and the last 12 months of security controls evidence we can share under NDA. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Marta_CS: Plan proposal: (1) schedule 30-min readout with procurement + new compliance lead + eng, (2) offer 14-day private eval + usage credit, (3) present perf/cost side-by-side and suggested rollback/tuning. Ruben/Priya/Olivia please be on the call.

Ethan_CSM: Draft outreach to customer — please tweak: 

"Hi StrataLink team — we noticed embed volume and seat activity declined recently. We'd like 25 minutes to share a tailored perf & cost readout, walk through a short remediation bundle (14-day private eval + usage credit), and align on compliance evidence you need for procurement. Would Tue/Thu next week work? — Ethan"

Priya_Security: +1. Add: "we'll include a SOC2 evidence packet under NDA and a short checklist for procurement" to steer away from headline price questions.

Ruben_SE: I'll have a short heatmap + KV hit slides ready. If it's a cache/cold-key issue, rollback to prior embed variant should restore volume within 24h; will include expected delta numbers.

audit-bot: SOC2 evidence request ticket created: TICK-445 (owner: Priya_Security)

Olivia_RevOps: Sent last invoice INV-11345 to Marta. Legal looped for private-eval addendum & promo T&Cs. Marking renewal-risk and urgent.

Marta_CS: Scheduling Tue 9am PT readout. Thanks team — will update thread after call with outcomes and next steps.
